excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Alibaba's wholesale platform 1688 officially launched the cross-border e-commerce AI agent "Ao Xia," intelligently matching cross-border entrepreneurs with quality factories and efficiently digitizing the process from product selection to supply chain integration. Centered on "AI + supply chain," "Ao Xia" integrates image recognition, link parsing, and natural language interaction technologies, covering key stages such as product decision-making, factory sourcing, intelligent pricing inquiries, and content generation to provide a one-stop smart digital supply chain solution. Users can initiate a conversation, upload product images, or input product links to start the full process from market research to factory connection with a single click. Apart from order placement and payment requiring user confirmation, all other steps can be automated by AI. Currently, the "Ao Xia" AI agent is available for a limited time for free on the official website (alphashop.cn), serving global cross-border professionals under the overseas brand name AlphaShop. (Ao Xia user interface screenshot) Data shows that China has approximately over a million active cross-border e-commerce merchants, while domestic e-commerce sellers exceed ten million. Encouraging more domestic merchants to expand overseas is becoming a new growth driver. Currently, 1688's annual cross-border transaction volume has surpassed 200 billion yuan, but issues like blind product selection, inefficient factory sourcing, high communication costs, slow responses, and weak design capabilities have long hindered the development of small and medium-sized businesses. The launch of "Ao Xia" aims to systematically address these problems by reshaping cross-border operational efficiency through AI. In the product selection phase, "Ao Xia" automatically generates insights based on data from mainstream e-commerce platforms and consumer trends.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, la plataforma de productos de fábrica 1688, propiedad de Alibaba, lanzó oficialmente el agente de IA para comercio transfronterizo "Ao Xia", que conecta inteligentemente a emprendedores internacionales con fábricas de calidad y agiliza digitalmente el proceso desde la selección de productos hasta la integración de la cadena de suministro. Centrado en "IA + cadena de suministro", "Ao Xia" combina reconocimiento de imágenes, análisis de enlaces e interacción en lenguaje natural, abarcando decisiones de selección, búsqueda de fábricas, consultas inteligentes de precios y generación de contenido, ofreciendo una solución integral digitalizada. Los usuarios solo necesitan iniciar un diálogo, subir una imagen del producto o introducir un enlace para activar con un clic todo el flujo, desde la investigación de mercado hasta el contacto con fábricas. Excepto por la confirmación de pedidos y pagos, que requieren validación del usuario, el resto de los pasos se gestionan automáticamente.

items.title: 2025字节跳动奖学金公布：奖金翻倍至20万元，追加奖励导师10万元
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，2025年字节跳动奖学金颁奖典礼在北京举行，共20位博士获奖。相比往届，此次奖学金不仅增加了获奖名额，也将奖学金从10万元升级为20万元（含10万元现金、10万元专项学术资源补贴）。此外，字节跳动还为每位获奖同学的导师提供10万元奖励，感谢导师在学子成长与科研道路上的付出。 图：20位获奖同学合影 字节跳动奖学金计划始于2021年，希望寻找并激励最优秀的技术在校生，助力其学术及科研，用技术回馈社会。过去五年，该计划已经为67位优秀学子提供了科研支持。 据统计，2025年字节跳动奖学金计划收到了中国、新加坡66所高校500余名同学的申请。经过严格评审，来自清华、北大、人大、复旦、华中科技大学、香港大学、新加坡国立大学、南洋理工大学的20位学子获奖，覆盖大模型、机器学习、多模态、AI Infra、机器人、AI for Science、硬件等多个研究领域。 本届字节跳动奖学金获奖名单中，清华和北大入选的人数最多，各入选6人。人大和香港大学也各有2位同学获奖。获奖同学表示，字节奖学金是对他们研究成果的认可，也通过该项目，接触到工业界的技术实践、认识到不同研究领域的优秀人才。一些获奖导师表示，此前已经和字节在相关研究领域开展了深入合作，字节为高校学术研究和人才培养提供了资源支持。 颁奖典礼上，字节跳动技术副总裁杨震原对获奖师生表示祝贺，并分享了字节跳动在大规模推荐系统、AI for Science、XR、大模型等领域长期探索的经验，鼓励同学们保持耐心和热爱，挑战真正有高度的技术难题，为社会创造更大价值。

Recently, the 2025 ByteDance Scholarship award ceremony was held in Beijing, honoring 20 doctoral recipients. Compared to previous years, this edition increased the number of awards and raised the scholarship amount from 100,000 yuan to 200,000 yuan, which includes 100,000 yuan in cash and 100,000 yuan in dedicated academic resource subsidies. Additionally, ByteDance provided a 100,000 yuan reward to each recipient's supervisor in recognition of their contributions to the students' growth and research endeavors. 

The ByteDance Scholarship program was launched in 2021 with the aim of identifying and motivating top technical students to support their academic and research efforts, encouraging them to give back to society through technology. Over the past five years, the program has provided research support to 67 outstanding students. 

Statistics show that the 2025 ByteDance Scholarship program received applications from over 500 students across 66 universities in China and Singapore. After a rigorous selection process, 20 students from Tsinghua University, Peking University, Renmin University of China, Fudan University, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, the University of Hong Kong, the National University of Singapore, and Nanyang Technological University were awarded. Their research areas span large models, machine learning, multimodal AI, AI infrastructure, robotics, AI for Science, hardware, and more. 

Among the 2025 recipients, Tsinghua University and Peking University had the highest number of awardees, with six each. Renmin University of China and the University of Hong Kong each had two students honored. The recipients noted that the ByteDance Scholarship acknowledges their research achievements and has allowed them to engage with industry practices and connect with outstanding talents across various research fields. Some supervising faculty expressed appreciation for the program.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, se celebró en Pekín la ceremonia de entrega de las Becas ByteDance 2025, donde 20 doctorandos resultaron galardonados. En comparación con ediciones anteriores, esta convocatoria no solo incrementó el número de becados, sino que también elevó el importe de la beca de 100.000 a 200.000 yuanes (incluyendo 100.000 en efectivo y 100.000 como subsidio específico para recursos académicos). Además, ByteDance otorgó 100.000 yuanes a cada tutor de los estudiantes premiados, en reconocimiento a su dedicación en la formación académica y la trayectoria investigadora de los alumnos. El programa de becas de ByteDance, iniciado en 2021, busca identificar y estimular a los estudiantes técnicos más destacados, apoyando su desarrollo académico y científico para que contribuyan a la sociedad mediante la tecnología. En los últimos cinco años, la iniciativa ha beneficiado a 67 talentos excepcionales.

items.title: 豆包联合浙江大学哲学学院，共同成立“AI人文创新实验室”
items.raw_excerpt: 近日，豆包AI联合浙江大学哲学学院，共同成立“AI人文创新实验室”。双方将持续举办课程与训练营，培养学生的AI素养和实践能力，并开展大学生AI使用行为与需求的长期调研，收集产品模型与功能的真实反馈，发掘更多师生群体的独特用法。 25日下午，浙江大学哲学学院-豆包合作协议签约仪式在浙江大学紫金港校区举行，双方代表共同为新成立的“AI人文创新实验室”揭牌。哲学学院院长王俊在现场表示，“AI人文创新实验室”这个跨界舞台不是新技术和人文的简单叠加，而是要构建一套“人文引领技术、技术反哺人文”的共生体系。希望借助此次合作，培养学生“用人文思维驾驭技术、用技术手段阐释人文”的复合能力。 签约仪式结束后，首期“AI+人文”创新实践能力素养提升训练营开办，哲学学院专业教师、豆包AI技术专家担任指导。 训练营现场 来自哲学学院等文科专业的59位学员分成10个小组，动用学科知识，将专业知识转化为可视化成果、高效学习助手与创新应用方案。有人用AI构建连接自然植物与传统文化的科普程序，有人想开发能帮助大家用原著语言学习《理想国》的AI应用。 这不是豆包与浙江大学哲学学院的首次合作。2025年5月，豆包走进浙江大学哲学学院，学生现场上手尝试生成编程应用，将AI与哲学结合，制作各类程序和网页。 除浙大外，豆包还先后走进北大、复旦等多所知名高校，联合开办AI训练营和课程。豆包相关负责人表示，豆包正在成为大学生群体辅助学习、丰富表达、自我提升的工具。接下来，豆包将持续走进更多院校，为高校师生更好地使用AI提供助力。

excerpt_i18n.en: Recently, Doubao AI partnered with the School of Philosophy at Zhejiang University to jointly establish the "AI Humanities Innovation Laboratory." The two parties will continue to organize courses and training camps to cultivate students' AI literacy and practical skills, conduct long-term research on university students' AI usage behaviors and needs, gather authentic feedback on product models and functions, and explore unique applications among more faculty and student groups. On the afternoon of the 25th, the signing ceremony for the cooperation agreement between the School of Philosophy at Zhejiang University and Doubao was held at Zhejiang University's Zijingang Campus, where representatives from both sides unveiled the newly established "AI Humanities Innovation Laboratory." Wang Jun, Dean of the School of Philosophy, stated on-site that this cross-disciplinary platform is not a simple combination of new technology and humanities but aims to build a symbiotic system where "humanities guide technology and technology enriches humanities." He expressed hope that through this collaboration, students will develop the composite ability to "use humanistic thinking to master technology and employ technological means to interpret humanities." Following the signing ceremony, the first "AI + Humanities" innovation practice skills enhancement training camp was launched, with professional faculty from the School of Philosophy and Doubao AI technical experts serving as instructors. At the training camp, 59 participants from humanities majors such as the School of Philosophy were divided into 10 groups, applying their disciplinary knowledge to transform specialized expertise into visual outcomes, efficient learning assistants, and innovative application solutions. Some used AI to create educational programs linking natural plants with traditional culture, while others aimed to develop AI applications to help people study "The Republic" in its original language. This is not the first collaboration between Doubao and the School of Philosophy at Zhejiang University. In May 2025, Doubao entered Zhejiang University.
excerpt_i18n.es: Recientemente, Doubao AI y la Facultad de Filosofía de la Universidad de Zhejiang establecieron conjuntamente el "Laboratorio de Innovación en IA y Humanidades".
